Set ONLY lambda_j=q, every other activity1; f(q)=E t and f-prime=Var(X_j)/(v_j q). For MIXED signs, I subset[-N0,N0]; choose integer H>=2+N0(1+V). Thus qlo=eta/(16H^S),qhi=16H^S/eta give relaxed brackets f(qlo)<=tau+eta,f(qhi)>=tau-eta by geometric sums, WITHOUT acquiring extrema. Otherwise orient v>=0: a nonsingleton class is unbounded with gaps<=J and min I>=-N0. At q<=1, f(q)-min I<=q exp(q), so qlo=eta/16 works. Every bracket has O_R(L) ORDINARY rational bits. No saturated-index/class or support enumeration assumption is used.
